answer: The delta multiplier is published, charged in raven, and timber lists each payment. A burst of registrations as a result prices itself out, because the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 12 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 4878 identities would post 1757 proofs and burn roughly 19 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
